source.title: Exposition on Psalm 33
source.breadcrumbs: Home > Fathers of the Church > Expositions on the Psalms (Augustine) > Psalm 33

paragraphs.text: Exposition on Psalm 33

1. <quote>Rejoice in the Lord, O you righteous:</quote> rejoice, O you righteous, not in yourselves, for that is not safe; but in the Lord. <quote>For praise is comely to the upright</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 32:1}} : these praise the Lord, who submit themselves unto the Lord; for else they are distorted and perverse.

2. <quote>Praise the Lord with harp:</quote> praise the Lord, presenting unto Him your bodies a living sacrifice. {{BIBLE:rom 12:1}} <quote>Sing unto Him with the psaltery for ten strings</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 32:2}} : let your members be servants to the love of God, and of your neighbour, in which are kept both the three and the seven commandments.

3. <quote>Sing unto Him a new song:</quote> sing unto Him a song of the grace of faith. <quote>Sing skilfully unto Him with jubilation</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 32:3}} : sing skillfully unto Him with rejoicing.

4. <quote>For the Word of the Lord is right:</quote> for the Word of the Lord is right, to make you that which of yourselves ye cannot be. <quote>And all His works are done in faith</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 32:4}} : lest any think that by the merit of works he has arrived at faith, when in faith are done all the works which God Himself loves.

5. <quote>He loves Mercy and Judgment:</quote> for He loves Mercy, which now He shows first; and Judgment, wherewith He exacts that which He has first shown. <quote>The earth is full of the Mercy of the Lord</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 32:5}} : throughout the whole world are sins forgiven unto men by the Mercy of the Lord.

6. <quote>By the Word of the Lord were the heavens made firm:</quote> for not by themselves, but by the Word of the Lord were the righteous made strong. <quote>And all the strength of them by the Breath of His Mouth</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 32:6}} . And all their faith by His Holy Spirit.

7. <quote>He gathers the waters of the sea together as into a bottle:</quote> He gathered the people of the world together, to confession of mortified sin, lest through pride they flow too freely. <quote>He lays up the deep in storehouses</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 32:7}} : and keeps in them His secrets for riches.

8. <quote>Let all the earth fear the Lord:</quote> let every sinner fear, that so he may cease to sin. <quote>Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of Him</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 32:8}} : not of the terrors of men, or of any creature, but of Him let them stand in awe.

9. <quote>For He spoke, and they were made:</quote> for no other one made those things which are to fear; but He spoke, and they were made. <quote>He commanded, and they were created</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 32:9}} : He commanded by His Word, and they were created.

10. <quote>The Lord brings the counsel of the heathen to nought;</quote> of them that seek not His Kingdom, but kingdoms of their own. <quote>He makes the devices of the people of none effect:</quote> of them that covet earthly happiness. <quote>And reproves the counsels of princes</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 32:10}} : of them that seek to rule over such peoples.

11. <quote>But the counsel of the Lord stands for ever;</quote> but the counsel of the Lord, whereby He makes none blessed but him that submits unto Himself, stands for ever. The thoughts of His Heart to all generations {{BIBLE:psa 32:11}} : the thoughts of His Wisdom are not mutable, but endure to all generations.

12. <quote>Blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord:</quote> one nation is blessed, belonging to the heavenly city, which has not chosen save the Lord for their God: <quote>And the people whom He has chosen for His own inheritance</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 32:12}} : and which not of itself, but by the gift of God, has been chosen, that He by possessing it may not suffer it to be uncared for and miserable.

13. <quote>The Lord looks from Heaven; He beholds all the sons of men</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 32:13}} . From the souls of the righteous, the Lord looks mercifully upon all who would rise to newness of life.

14. <quote>From His prepared habitation:</quote> from His habitation of assumed Humanity, which He prepared for Himself. <quote>He looks upon all the inhabitants of the earth</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 32:14}} : He looks mercifully upon all who live in the flesh, that He may be over them in ruling them.

15. <quote>He fashions their hearts singly:</quote> He gives spiritually to their hearts their proper gifts, so that neither the whole body may be eye, nor the whole hearing; {{BIBLE:1co 12:17}} but that one in this manner, another in that manner, may be incorporated with Christ. <quote>He understands all their works</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 32:15}} . Before Him are all their works understood.

16. <quote>A king shall not be saved by much strength:</quote> he shall not be saved who rules his own flesh, if he presume much upon his own strength. <quote>Neither shall a giant be saved by much strength</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 32:16}} : nor shall he be saved whoever wars against the habit of his own lust, or against the devil and his angels, if he trust much to his own might.

17. <quote>A horse is a deceitful thing for safety:</quote> he is deceived, who thinks either that through men he gains salvation received among men, or that by the impetuosity of his own courage he is defended from destruction. <quote>In the abundance of his strength shall he not be saved</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 32:17}} .

18. <quote>Behold, the Eyes of the Lord are upon them that fear Him:</quote> because if you seek salvation, behold, the love of the Lord is upon them that fear Him. <quote>Upon them that hope in His mercy</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 32:18}} : that hope not in their own strength, but in His mercy.

19. <quote>To deliver their souls from death, and to keep them alive in famine</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 32:19}} . To give them the nourishment of the Word, and of Everlasting Truth, which they lost while presuming on their own strength, and therefore have not even their own strength, from lack of righteousness.

20. <quote>My soul shall be patient for the Lord:</quote> that hereafter it may be filled with dainties incorruptible, meanwhile, while here it remains, my soul shall be patient for the Lord. <quote>For He is our Helper and Defender</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 32:20}} : our Helper He is, while we endeavour after Him; and our Defender, while we resist the adversary.

21. <quote>For our heart shall rejoice in Him:</quote> for not in ourselves, wherein without Him there is great need; but in Himself shall our heart rejoice. <quote>And we have trusted in His holy Name</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 32:21}} ; and therefore have we trusted that we shall come to God, because unto us absent has He sent, through faith, His own Name.

22. <quote>Let Your mercy, O Lord, be upon us, according as we have hoped in You</quote> {{BIBLE:psa 32:22}} : let Your mercy, O Lord, be upon us; for hope confounds not, because we have hoped in You.

latex.p0002: 1. \BibleQuote{义人们，请在上主内欢欣：}义人们，不要在自己内欢欣，因为那并不安全；但要欢欣于上主。\BibleQuote{赞美在正直人原是美善。}\BibleRef{咏 32:1}：这些赞美上主的人，是顺从上主的人；否则他们就是扭曲和乖谬的。
latex.p0003: 2. \BibleQuote{弹着竖琴赞美上主：}赞美上主，将你们的身体奉献给祂，作为生活的祭献。\BibleRef{罗 12:1}\BibleQuote{弹着十弦瑟歌咏祂。}\BibleRef{咏 32:2}：让你们的肢体服侍于爱天主和爱近人，其中遵守了三诫和七诫。
latex.p0004: 3. \BibleQuote{你们应向上主唱新歌：}向祂咏唱信德恩宠之歌。\BibleQuote{在欢呼声中向祂弹奏吟咏。}\BibleRef{咏 32:3}：在喜乐中向祂弹奏吟咏。
latex.p0005: 4. \BibleQuote{因为上主的话是正直的：}因为上主的话是正直的，要使你们成为你们靠自己无法成为的。\BibleQuote{祂的一切工作都忠信可靠。}\BibleRef{咏 32:4}：免得有人以为凭行为的功绩达到了信德，其实天主所喜爱的一切行为都是在信德中完成的。
latex.p0006: 5. \BibleQuote{祂喜爱慈悲和公道：}因为祂喜爱慈悲——如今祂首先显示慈悲；也喜爱公道——祂以此要求祂所先显示的。\BibleQuote{上主的慈爱弥漫大地。}\BibleRef{咏 32:5}：普世之中，罪过因上主的慈悲而获得赦免。
latex.p0007: 6. \BibleQuote{藉上主的话，诸天得以建立：}因为义人不是靠他们自己，而是藉上主的话得以坚强。\BibleQuote{藉祂口中的气息，万军得以形成。}\BibleRef{咏 32:6}。他们所有的信德是藉着祂的圣神。
latex.p0008: 7. \BibleQuote{祂将海中的水聚集成堆：}祂将世界上的百姓聚集起来，使他们承认已死的罪过，免得他们因骄傲而随意流散。\BibleQuote{祂将深渊收藏在库房里。}\BibleRef{咏 32:7}：并将祂的奥秘保存在他们里面，作为宝藏。
latex.p0009: 8. \BibleQuote{愿全地都敬畏上主：}愿每一个罪人敬畏，好使他停止犯罪。\BibleQuote{愿世上的居民都畏惧祂。}\BibleRef{咏 32:8}：不要畏惧人的恐吓或任何受造之物，而要畏惧祂。
latex.p0010: 9. \BibleQuote{因为祂一发言，它们就形成：}因为那应当畏惧的事物并非由他人造成，而是祂一发言，它们就形成。\BibleQuote{祂一出命，它们就被创造。}\BibleRef{咏 32:9}：祂藉祂的圣言一命，它们就被创造。
latex.p0011: 10. \BibleQuote{上主使异邦人的计谋落空：}那些不寻求祂的国，而寻求自己国的人。\BibleQuote{祂使万民的计划失效：}那些贪求现世幸福的人。\BibleQuote{并挫败王侯的谋略。}\BibleRef{咏 32:10}：那些寻求统治这般百姓的人。
latex.p0012: 11. \BibleQuote{上主的谋略却永远常存；}然而上主的谋略——祂使那顺服于祂的人有福——永远常存。\BibleQuote{祂心中的思念流传万代。}\BibleRef{咏 32:11}：祂智慧的思念不可变更，延续至万代。
latex.p0013: 12. \BibleQuote{以天主为自己上主的民族是有福的：}有一个民族是有福的，她属于天上之城，只选择了上主为她的天主：\BibleQuote{祂为自己选定的子民。}\BibleRef{咏 32:12}：这子民不是出于自己，而是因天主的恩赐被拣选，以便祂拥有他们，不让他们无人照料而悲惨。
latex.p0014: 13. \BibleQuote{上主从天上俯视，看见所有的人类。}\BibleRef{咏 32:13}。上主从义人的灵魂中，慈悲地注视所有愿意更新生命的人。
latex.p0015: 14. \BibleQuote{从祂所预备的居所：}从祂所取的人性的居所，祂为自己预备的。\BibleQuote{祂注视地上所有的居民。}\BibleRef{咏 32:14}：祂慈悲地注视所有生活在肉身之内的人，为要治理他们。
latex.p0016: 15. \BibleQuote{祂逐个塑造他们的心：}祂以属灵的方式赐予他们的心脏适当的恩赐，使得全身不全是眼，也不全是耳，\BibleRef{格前 12:17}而是一人如此，另一人如彼，得以与基督结合。\BibleQuote{祂明了他们所有的作为。}\BibleRef{咏 32:15}。在祂面前，他们所有的作为都被明了。
latex.p0017: 16. \BibleQuote{君王不因兵力强大而获胜：}那统治自己肉身的人，若过度信赖自己的力量，将不得救。\BibleQuote{巨人也不因力量强大而自救。}\BibleRef{咏 32:16}：那与自身私欲的习惯或与魔鬼及其使者争战的人，若过度信赖自己的勇力，也将不得救。
latex.p0018: 17. \BibleQuote{马匹为得救是虚幻的：}那人受欺骗，以为藉着人可得着在人间获得的救恩，或以为靠自己的勇力之冲动能免于毁灭。\BibleQuote{它虽力大，却不能救人。}\BibleRef{咏 32:17}。
latex.p0019: 18. \BibleQuote{看，上主的眼目垂顾敬畏祂的人：}因为如果你寻求救恩，看，上主的慈爱临于敬畏祂的人。\BibleQuote{眷顾那些期望祂仁慈的人。}\BibleRef{咏 32:18}：那些不期望自己的力量，而期望祂仁慈的人。
latex.p0020: 19. \BibleQuote{为救他们的灵魂免于死亡，并在饥荒中养活他们。}\BibleRef{咏 32:19}。赐予他们圣言的滋养和永恒真理的滋养——他们因信赖自己的力量而失去了这滋养，因此连自己的力量也没有了，因为缺乏正义。
latex.p0021: 20. \BibleQuote{我的灵魂切望上主：}为叫它将来得以享受不朽坏的美味，同时在此停留期间，我的灵魂切望上主。\BibleQuote{因为祂是我们的助佑和盾牌。}\BibleRef{咏 32:20}：当我们努力趋向祂时，祂是我们的助佑；当我们抵抗仇敌时，祂是我们的盾牌。
latex.p0022: 21. \Quote{因为我们的心要因祂欢欣：}因为不在我们自己内，在其中没有祂就有极大需要；而是在祂自己内，我们的心要欢欣。\Quote{我们已信赖了祂的圣名} \BibleRef{咏 32:21}；因此我们信赖我们将来到天主面前，因为对我们这些远离的人，祂借着信德，派遣了祂自己的圣名。
latex.p0023: 22. \Quote{上主，求祢的仁慈临于我们，因为我们寄望于祢} \BibleRef{咏 32:22}：上主，求祢的仁慈临于我们，因为望德不会蒙羞，因为我们寄望于祢。
